game.name: Real Racing 3
game.desc: The 2013 racing game by Firemint/Firemonkeys. Port by EapRules: it runs the original Android ARM library directly through a bionic/JNI compatibility loader, with no emulator and no Android runtime. Bring your own Real Racing 3 2.7.0 Android install - no game data is included, and the APK alone is not enough: the ~2.6 GB of tracks, cars and audio are downloaded content and EA's server for it is gone, so a backup of the app's data folder is needed. Races on an RK3326 handheld at around 15-20 fps.
